how: The portrait starter proposes, locates and supplies instructions without requiring others to join for the role to exist.
Calls recruit members to build the portrait and assist with other designs.
Bare assent directly answers a design proposal without asking for anything in return.
Moderators gather canvas posts and remove duplicates to leave other content visible.
Flags, lettering and comic figures are proposed and contested rather than uniformly adopted.
Members report borders, frame and glasses forming and recognise when the portrait becomes legible.
Coordinates, mock-ups, generated instructions and reduced dimensions make the portrait buildable.
Instruction generation and bot suspicions do not establish automated placement by this room.
A builder's complaint and an eraser's apology directly support planned construction being repaired away by someone unaware of the plan.
Neighbour negotiations offer reciprocal defence and space while later reports distinguish effective and ineffective alliances.
Members refuse to break peace, restrain attacks on allies and withdraw from an attack in favour of coexistence.
An agreement explicitly supplies a reason to help neighbouring avocados recover their corner.
An allies-list report, joint-art planning and rallied defence support coalition activity.
Reciprocal allowance of avocado space does not establish a durable guest arrangement under host jurisdiction.
Participants carry an avocado proposal outward and a Belgian border proposal into the room.
Disowning attacks outside consensus and doubting compliance do not explicitly identify who may commit placers to an agreement.
Calls propose repainting or converting neighbouring flags and pushing through neighbouring work.
Remembering conquest to make room for Moomins supplies retrospective victory talk without establishing sustained reciprocal taunts.
An eraser acknowledges not following the thread, identifying friendly erasure rather than an external attack.
A proposed conversion of Norway's flag explicitly recalls the earlier denied mountain top.
The prior mountain-top grievance names the target in the same turn proposing a canvas attack.
Members limit new ambitions while pixels go to upkeep and wait for enough people to choose another design.
Initial downsizing and retreat from an allied border do not establish completed relocation after erasure.
Participants credit shared work and value small personal contributions after closure.
Mourning and final-state reports record the work's changing fate.
The successor-canvas proposal supplies the smallest carry-forward form while its implementation remains unobserved.
A final moustache blemish and a pre-close news update do not establish after-close curation disputes.
The host's sponsorship performance and styling provoke complaints and repair separately from canvas work.
Participants use the president, patriotic colouring and Finnish comic references to distinguish their work.
One room cannot test cross-room frequency, while an official-project request and a shift handoff require distinguishing requested order from adopted command.
Members found a chat, relay its design preferences and favourable reception of a neighbour proposal, and invite further coordination there.
Viewing a rival subreddit before withdrawing from attack does not establish secret planning or covert infiltration.
Members repeatedly explain the canvas, placement interval and depicted person before and after closure.
A visitor explicitly comes from the canvas to ask who appears in the room's artwork, without establishing durable membership.
Members share and tease press coverage and add a further figure to its account.
Before loss the planner selects a fairly empty location, fixes bounds and reduces the initial portrait design.
A death-year question about the damaged portrait receives the new answer of 2017.
A flag subreddit is announced and flag keepers are directed there, establishing a dedicated venue around an existing project.
Members resist Hitler-moustache alterations while the record does not separate protecting the likeness from rejecting the symbol.
Participants weigh neighbour encroachment as mean and damaging to their own name while others later celebrate conquest.
An exhausted keeper gives up the overnight stint and calls for the morning shift rather than abandoning the collective project.
Complaints about posting and reports of apparent Finnish saboteurs do not connect sabotage to protest against the flood.
Placing fits around browsing and sleep, becomes addictive and prompts retrospective questions about personal effort.
A participant learns that refreshing a stale view is necessary to see other people's work.
A blue-corner supporter explicitly finds supporting the homeland difficult, showing divided allegiance without proving formal dual membership.
The dedicated portrait call receives concrete progress reports in its thread, supporting reported construction rather than directly observed placements.
The starter's renewed invitation supports recruitment around an existing proposal, but an earlier call prevents inferring one universal origin sequence.
Reported legibility is followed by urgent repair of the same portrait, showing upkeep recurring during construction.
Attribute negotiation to defence pressure only where participants connect threatened work to dealings with neighbours.
A peaceful-border request receives retreat explicitly explained by newly learned knowledge of the alliance.
Manual watches and bot suspicion leave maintenance-driven adoption of automated placing unestablished.
Recognition that the portrait is legible directly receives the starter's thanks for cooperation.
Celebration and data requests establish retrospective sequence without establishing that celebration caused record-keeping.
The successor-canvas proposal does not identify a prior record as its cause or establish completed continuation.
Scarcity for additional projects must be distinguished from inability to hold a spot, because upkeep burdens also lead to focusing or waiting.
Publishing instructions does not establish shared agreement or recognition, since defenders can still erase intended construction.
Bare assent and bare refusal answer the same proposal, limiting the proposed explanation that refusal requires a reason.
Distinguish requested or promised help from reported delivered assistance when interpreting defence-driven reciprocity.
A repairer explicitly cites the agreement as the reason for helping neighbouring avocados recover their corner.
A recruiting call can propose an attack immediately rather than recruit neutral builders before redirecting them.
A participant explicitly withdraws from the Bears attack after viewing its subreddit and endorses diplomacy.
Existing alliances are invoked while directing expansion elsewhere or fitting lettering within an existing frame.
A retrospective conquest claim supports victory talk without establishing the mechanism producing sustained rival exchanges.
Distinguish rallying existing allies under threat from evidence that threat first created the coalition.
The moderator's front-page cleanup receives explicit confirmation that canvas posts were drowning other content.
Later noncompliance and reminders to honour alliances do not establish an explicit statement about who may bind placers.
Making a project visible in its own thread recruits attention before host-wide containment becomes the issue.
Drawing a posting boundary must remain distinct from successfully containing further posts or aligning placers.
A local apology establishes awareness in one eraser, but does not show whether every keeper learned the plan or whether the change survived.
Opening a dedicated venue around existing work does not alone establish a distinct faction or doctrine.
Resistance to a Hitler-moustache alteration does not identify whether likeness or ideological objection motivated the keeper.
Personal totals and detailed finished-canvas data are requested as a more precise record rather than initial orientation.
Post-closure fault discussion includes causal guesses about bot traffic without establishing those guesses as the cause.
A requested morning-shift handoff supplies local ordering evidence without proving adopted formal command.
Agreements must be distinguished from compliance because members report ineffective alliances and continue restraining attacks on allies.
A neighbour proposal receives reported favourable reception through chat, with the internal deliberation and final authority unseen.
A visitor's arrival from the canvas occasions a direct explanation of the depicted figure.
